claim: Let \(X\subset\mathbb P^4_{\mathbb C}\) be a smooth diagonal intersection of two quadrics with pairwise distinct pencil eigenvalues, and let \(A\cong(\mathbb Z/2)^4\) be its coordinate-sign subgroup. Across all \(35\) order-four subgroups \(H\le A\), the singularity, anticanonical degree, and smooth-locus fundamental-group triples of \(Y=X/H\) are exactly: \(10\) groups give \((\varnothing,9,1)\), \(15\) groups give \((4A_1,4,\mathbb Z/2)\), and \(10\) groups give \((6A_1,1,(\mathbb Z/2)^2)\). In the last case the universal quasi-étale cover is \(X\to Y\), and \(Y\) has a weighted-sextic equation \(v^2=uL_0L_1\) in \(\mathbb P(1,1,2,3)\), with explicitly specified quadratic \(L_i\).
integrity: Symbolic proof with standalone finite subgroup census; no computational sampling substituted for geometry
scientific_limitations: Complex characteristic zero, diagonal smooth quartic del Pezzo surfaces, canonical coordinate-sign automorphisms only.
Prior Trepalin quotients cover isolated basket and degree statements; no priority claimed for those cases.
Novelty assessment is based on inspected papers and limited indexed search, not independent certification.
title: The 35 Klein-four sign quotients of quartic del Pezzo surfaces: node baskets and smooth-locus fundamental groups
